entries.body: The registrar account has one login, held by the office manager, with multi-factor authentication on (an authenticator app). The account's recovery email is the personal address of a staff member who left the firm in 2023.
entries.label: VERIFIED
entries.source: Registrar console, account security page, viewed with the office manager

entries.body: Two domains at the registrar, both registered in 2019: wrenfield.example (the firm's main domain) and wrenfieldgroup.example (parked). Transfer lock (clientTransferProhibited) is on for both. The registry offers registry lock; it is not enabled on either. Auto-renew is off on both: wrenfield.example expires on 2027-03-18 and wrenfieldgroup.example on 2027-06-02. The payment method on file is the firm's company card, valid to 2028.
entries.label: VERIFIED
entries.source: Registrar console, domain list and each domain's settings; RDAP status for both domains

entries.body: The office manager's domain list names the two domains above, each with an owner and purpose. A second registrar account, found in the shared password manager during the audit under a former partner's name, holds two legacy domains, wrenfield-advisory.example and wrenfieldllc.example, that appear on no list.
entries.label: VERIFIED
entries.source: The office manager's domain spreadsheet; the second registrar account's domain list

entries.body: Whether the second registrar account holds anything beyond the two legacy domains (further domains, or domains in an expired or redemption state), and whose recovery contacts it carries, is not known.
entries.label: UNKNOWN
entries.source: Only the account's active domain list was viewed

entries.body: The DNS provider account has two logins, the office manager and the managing partner, both with two-step verification on. No other user has access; the contractor's login was removed in 2023.
entries.label: VERIFIED
entries.source: DNS provider console, users and security pages

entries.body: DNSSEC is not enabled for either zone: neither zone publishes DNSKEY records and the parent holds no DS record for either domain.
entries.label: VERIFIED
entries.source: DNS provider console, DNSSEC settings; DNS queries (DNSKEY at each apex, DS at the parent)

entries.body: The DNS provider's activity log records every zone change, with the login that made it. The most recent change was in 2025 (a TXT record added for a site verification).
entries.label: VERIFIED
entries.source: DNS provider console, activity log

entries.body: Nobody reviews the activity log; the office manager had not opened it before this audit.
entries.label: ON RECORD
entries.source: Interview with the office manager

entries.body: No copy of either zone's records exists outside the DNS provider: no export has been taken and no records file is kept.
entries.label: ON RECORD
entries.source: Interview with the office manager and the contractor

entries.body: The parent's nameserver records for wrenfield.example match the zone's own: two nameservers, both answering authoritatively with the same SOA serial, no lame server. Both nameservers belong to the one DNS provider and sit in its single network (one routing origin).
entries.label: VERIFIED
entries.source: DNS queries (NS at the parent and at each nameserver, SOA at each); routing origin lookup for each nameserver address

entries.body: Whether either nameserver answers a zone transfer (AXFR) request from an outside address is not known: it has never been tested.
entries.label: UNKNOWN
entries.source: Not yet tested

entries.body: wrenfield.example publishes one SPF record. It includes the hosted mail platform, the invoicing tool's sending service and a marketing platform, and ends in a soft fail (~all). It resolves within 7 DNS lookups.
entries.label: VERIFIED
entries.source: DNS query (TXT at the apex); lookup count traced through each include

entries.body: The firm stopped using the marketing platform in 2024; nobody has re-checked the SPF includes or DKIM selectors against the services in use since the 2021 setup.
entries.label: ON RECORD
entries.source: Interview with the office manager; the platform's final invoice

entries.body: Whether the marketing platform still sends anything using the domain is not known.
entries.label: UNKNOWN
entries.source: Not checked; the unread DMARC aggregate reports (D5) would show it

entries.body: DKIM: the hosted mail platform's two selectors publish 2048-bit RSA keys. No selector exists for the invoicing tool, and a sample invoice email received on the engagement date carries no DKIM signature.
entries.label: VERIFIED
entries.source: DNS queries (each selector's TXT record); headers of a sample invoice email

entries.body: DMARC for wrenfield.example: p=none, with no sp tag and no np tag. Aggregate reports (rua) go to a shared mailbox at wrenfield.example, which holds unread reports going back to 2023. The record was created in 2023 and has not changed since.
entries.label: VERIFIED
entries.source: DNS query (TXT at _dmarc); DNS provider activity log; the report mailbox, viewed with the office manager

entries.body: wrenfieldgroup.example (parked) sends no mail and publishes no MX, no SPF and no DMARC record.
entries.label: VERIFIED
entries.source: DNS queries (MX and TXT at the apex, TXT at _dmarc)

entries.body: Neither domain publishes an MTA-STS record (_mta-sts) or serves an MTA-STS policy host, an SMTP TLS reporting record (_smtp._tls), or a CAA record.
entries.label: VERIFIED
entries.source: DNS queries (TXT at _mta-sts and _smtp._tls, CAA at each apex); HTTPS request for the MTA-STS policy host

entries.body: Whether the hosted mail platform supports DANE for the firm's inbound mail has never been checked.
entries.label: UNKNOWN
entries.source: Not yet checked with the mail platform

entries.body: No list of the firm's subdomains exists; the contractor's 2021 setup notes name some of them.
entries.label: ON RECORD
entries.source: Interview with the office manager; the contractor's setup notes

entries.body: help.wrenfield.example is a CNAME to a hostname at the helpdesk service the firm left in 2024. The service answers that no site is configured for that name. The record has not changed since 2021.
entries.label: VERIFIED
entries.source: DNS query (CNAME); HTTPS request to the subdomain; DNS provider activity log

entries.body: projects.wrenfield.example is delegated by NS records to two nameservers under a former web vendor's domain; both answer for the subdomain. The delegation has not changed since 2022.
entries.label: VERIFIED
entries.source: DNS queries (NS for the subdomain, SOA at each delegated nameserver); DNS provider activity log

entries.body: Who operates the delegated nameservers for projects.wrenfield.example today, and what the subdomain now serves, is not known.
entries.label: UNKNOWN
entries.source: Follows from F3; not yet investigated

entries.body: A wildcard record, *.dev.wrenfield.example, points at a hosting address; any name under dev.wrenfield.example resolves to it.
entries.label: VERIFIED
entries.source: DNS queries (A for two random names under the wildcard); the zone's record list in the DNS provider console

entries.body: The contractor recalls the wildcard was added for preview sites during a 2022 development project; which project, and whether anything still uses it, is not recalled.
entries.label: ON RECORD
entries.source: Interview with the contractor
